banner.title: Spectral fingerprinting of ions
banner.tagline: Attempting to answer the age old question - How did life form?

projects.label: Molecular fingerprints
projects.title: Cryogenic Gas-phase Infrared Spectroscopy of Molecular Anions
projects.description: Using the FELion instrument coupled to a widely tunable infrared free electron laser called FELIX, this work records infrared gas-phase spectra of molecular anions in vacuum conditions.

projects.label: Atmospheres beyond our own
projects.title: High Resolution Ground-based Spectroscopy of Ultra-hot Jupiters
projects.description: Using the FOCES spectrograph at Wendelstein Observatory, this work explores atmospheric compositions of three ultra-hot Jupiters (KELT-20b, KELT-9b, and WASP-189b) through high-resolution spectroscopy.

projects.label: Where stars take shape
projects.title: Characterizing edge-effect in Star-Forming Filaments
projects.description: This simulation-based study examined how embedding in larger environments affects the edge-effect in star-forming filaments, offering a fresh lens on filament stability.

projects.label: The unseen architecture
projects.title: Dark Matter Mass elucidation by rotational curve decomposition
projects.description: Led a team that analytically studied the distribution of dark matter mass around 34 spiral galaxies using least-squares regression of rotational curves.

projects.label: Reading our nearest star
projects.title: Exploring correlations between Solar activity and other solar parameters
projects.description: Identified inverse correlation between sunspot area and flare activity parameters and built an ensemble boosting ML model with 79% accuracy to predict Solar Flare Index.
